page_title: ETI 0-2 HAV | St Etienne v Le Havre 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Florent Batta has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Florent Batta blows for a foul after Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) on the edge of the box.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Florent Batta didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) is caught offside!
85' Olivier Dall'Oglio prepares a substitution. Benjamin Old is replaced by Ayman Aiki (St Etienne).
85' Here's the change. Yassine Kechta leaves the pitch and Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.

85' A rebound falls to Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
83' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
82' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Arthur Desmas, who makes a comfortable save.
79' The move breaks down when Yvann Macon (St Etienne) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
78' Substitution. Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ibrahim Sissoko walks off.
77' The total number of attempts is 12:12. 4:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
75' Didier Digard is forced to make a change. Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Yoann Salmier.
72' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
69' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Oussama Targhalline will be replaced by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
69' Today's match ends for Arouna Sangante who will be replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
68' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Josue Casimir and he is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).

67' 0 - 2 Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Yanis Zouaoui. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:2.
67' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner.

65' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
65' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas was alert and made a comfortable save.
63' One of the players from Le Havre times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) replacing Florian Tardieu.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Zuriko Davitashvili walks off the pitch to be replaced by Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
62' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne).
59' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
58' Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
57' 0 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gautier Larsonneur into right side of the goal.
57' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
55' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Le Havre!
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.

54' Ambitious effort from Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
54' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) prepares to take a corner kick.

53' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. St Etienne will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

51' Mathis Amougou (St Etienne) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
51' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

51' Benjamin Old (St Etienne) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. St Etienne force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' Florent Batta interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
49' Loic Nego (Le Havre) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

48' Loic Nego sets up Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) for a shot from distance, but the effort is badly misjudged and it flies yards past the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Olivier Dall'Oglio probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Marwann Nzuzi (St Etienne). He is replaced by Dennis Appiah.
46' The whistle blows and Florent Batta starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Loic Nego (Le Havre) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
42' Florent Batta shows a yellow card to Josue Casimir (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
40' The referee is firm and issues Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) a deserved yellow card.
40' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

37' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Arthur Desmas shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

34' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
33' Marwann Nzuzi (St Etienne) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St Etienne, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' The game is interrupted now, Josue Casimir (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florent Batta saw the whole situation. Le Havre have a free kick.
29' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

27' What a great touch by Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
26' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.

25' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
23' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florent Batta has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Le Havre earn a free kick.
18' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

17' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the right post, but Gautier Larsonneur makes a decent save to stop the effort. It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.
17' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
16' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
15' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Le Havre was in an offside position.
11' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Le Havre.
10' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
9' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner but it's cleared.
6' The game is interrupted. Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
3' Loic Nego (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) makes a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and St Etienne will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Florent Batta.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
